transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see us today?

I've just completely lost interest in everything I used to enjoy, and it's been like this for about four months now. I don't have the motivation to do anything, and even my favorite hobbies feel completely pointless. I just feel exhausted all the time.
Have you experienced any periods of elevated mood or increased energy, even if brief, over the past few years, where you felt unusually happy, irritable, or had increased activity?

No, I haven't had any times like that at all. My mood has just been consistently low, heavy, and completely exhausted for as long as I can remember. There haven't been any periods where I felt happy or had extra energy over the last few years.

Can you tell me more about how long you've been feeling this way, specifically if it's been continuous for the past four months or if there have been any variations in your symptoms over the past two years?

Yes, it has been continuous and constant every single day for the past four months. Before this started four months ago, I didn't experience anything like this at all over the last two years. These feelings are completely new to me.

Have you experienced any significant changes or stressors in your life around the time your symptoms started, about four months ago, or have your symptoms been present most of the day, more days than not, for at least two years if you had to look back further?

No, this has definitely only been going on for the last four months, not for two years. I also can't think of any major life changes or stressful events that happened around that time to trigger how I'm feeling.
How have your symptoms affected your daily life, relationships, and ability to function at work or school over the past four months?

It has completely disrupted my daily life over the last four months because I've withdrawn from my friends and family and have no energy for basic tasks. I also have zero motivation to do my work, so I've just been falling behind on everything. It feels like I'm completely unable to function right now.
I'm sorry, I didn't quite catch what you just said. Could you please repeat or clarify your question for me?
To confirm, you've had a consistent low mood and loss of interest in activities for the past four months, but prior to that, you didn't experience these symptoms for two years, is that correct?

Yes, that is exactly right. I have only been feeling this way for the past four months, and before that, I didn't have any of these problems. It is all very new to me compared to how I was during those two years prior.

Can you think of any times over the past two years, before these four months, when you might have had a period of low mood or loss of interest that lasted for at least two years, even if it wasn't as severe as what you're experiencing now?
No, I really can't recall having any long periods of low mood or losing interest in things before these past four months. My life and mood felt completely normal prior to this starting.

To confirm again, you're certain that before the past four months, you didn't experience any persistent feelings of sadness, hopelessness, or loss of interest that lasted for two years or more, which would be less severe than your current symptoms but still present?

Yes, I am absolutely certain of that. I never had any long-term feelings of sadness, hopelessness, or loss of interest for two years or more prior to this. Everything really just started about four months ago.

The lack of a long-term history of depressive symptoms prior to the past four months (less than two years) reduces the likelihood of Persistent Depressive Disorder, which requires symptoms to be present for at least two years. Therefore, Major Depressive Disorder is the most fitting diagnosis based on the information provided.
